action_items: INVESTIGATE: Hush Music Live channel shows 'No playable videos' after YouTube error 150. The live stream video ID (yfG9FPgFoLM) is valid ABC News Live. May need to handle proxy fallback differently for live stream channels or try alternative live stream URL.

critical_code_review_comments: The is_live_stream and live_stream_youtube_id fields are correctly implemented in backend
Frontend correctly identifies live stream channels and sets is_live: true flag

POTENTIAL BUG: In LiveTV.jsx tryProxyFallback(), when proxy fails for any video, it calls skipToNextVideo(). For live streams, this results in 'No playable videos' since there's no next video. The isLive check at line 667 should prevent this, but console shows skipToNextVideo was called.
Schedule time parsing fix (parseTimeToSeconds) is implemented correctly - handles HH:MM:SS strings from backend

context_for_next_testing_agent: Live stream channel 'Hush Music Live' (sort_order 30) is correctly configured with is_live_stream=true and live_stream_youtube_id='yfG9FPgFoLM' (ABC News Live). The backend API returns correct data. Frontend shows 'No playable videos' error after YouTube error 150. Need to investigate why the live stream is hitting error handler and being treated as unplayable. The error handler in LiveTV.jsx has isLive protection but may not be working correctly in all code paths.
rca_of_the_issue: The Hush Music Live channel correctly has is_live_stream: true in database and API. The LiveTV.jsx selectChannel() correctly sets currentVideo.is_live: true. The YouTube player initialization includes isLive checks. However, when YouTube returns error 150 (embed blocked), the onError handler checks isLive and shows toast, but subsequent proxy fallback may still be triggering skipToNextVideo. Since live streams have no next video, this results in 'No playable videos' message. Root cause may be: 1) Race condition between multiple error handlers, 2) The specific ABC News live stream URL may have embed restrictions, 3) Browser/environment specific issue with YouTube IFrame API.
